objective: Implement the code-only VS01-T02B source-admission kernel with strict portable FetchReceipt, SourceSnapshot, and AdmissionDecision contracts, one-source CLI acquisition, synthetic GitHub and WEB transports, quarantine validation, immutable content-addressed promotion, and idempotent snapshot handling without contacting the network or writing the real archive.
activated_user_visible_capability: A reviewed local command can acquire and admit one approved SOURCE-PLAN-01 source through a deterministic, rights-aware, content-addressed workflow after a later live-execution authorization.
activated_invariants: The implementation is based on exact main 65a6bf333b53e497652a8fa3676ed00413c35d40.
The task runs only in the isolated worktree /Users/joseph/.codex/worktrees/bsl-vs01-t02b.
